variable_coverage.construction: Compound raw CRSP daily security returns from two days after the prior Compustat RDQ through the day after current-period RDQ; the source reports approximately 60 trading days. Do not replace buy-and-hold return with an arithmetic sum.

Product of FEGAAP and POST92; exact GAAP item mapping remains unresolved.

implementation_issues.description: The Data section identifies Compustat quarterly income item #8 for EPSGAAP, while Table 1 note identifies item #25. Current Compustat fields have not been declared equivalent to either historical code; the conflict is preserved.

The article explicitly uses I/B/E/S monthly stock prices to scale both forecast errors; no corresponding I/B/E/S price field/resource was verified in the local catalog/probes. CRSP PRC is not source-equivalent.

The 1985–1997 sample range conflicts with the statement that coverage begins in 1986; the article also reports 4,919 initial observations in 1985. Table 1 period is preserved for the selected fit, but the first-year handling is unresolved.
The paper does not name the regression estimator, standard-error method or clustering correction for Table 1 Model 3.
Street EPS actuals exclude selected charges, but the paper’s general nonrecurring-charge discussion does not specify a complete charge-level coding rule for the local actual series.

review_notes: The Table 1 Model 3 joint fit is retained; the separate Street-only and GAAP-only models are not baseline scopes for this assigned work item. The reported period conflict is kept. I/B/E/S prices are explicitly required; no CRSP-price proxy is treated as equivalent.
